2607.28076.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2607.28076.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch current experience, exceed the policy's capability, or remain path-specific. We propose Group-Reflective Self-Distillation (GRSD), which derives capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative guidance from the policy's own verified rollouts. For each prompt, the policy reflects on each verified trajectory in an on-policy group, and a stop-gradient snapshot contrasts the resulting reflections from successful and failed rollouts to construct group-level privileged guidance. Conditioned on this guidance, a self-teacher refines turn-level credit assignment by modulating outcome-based advantages while preserving the verifier-determined learning direction. Experiments across multiple agentic environments and model scales demonstrate that GRSD consistently outperforms competitive baselines and generalizes more effectively to unseen tasks.
2607.28076.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵（RLVR）對於訓練大型語言模型代理非常有效。<lb/>然而，終端獎勵僅提供粗略的軌跡級別監督，讓成功行為、重複錯誤和偶然選擇交織在同一結果信號中。<lb/>現有的代理自蒸餾方法通過自然語言技能豐富稀疏的監督，但從外部檢索的技能或由更強模型從單一軌跡中提取的技能可能與當前經驗不匹配、超出策略的能力或仍然是路徑特定的。<lb/>我們提出了群體反思自蒸餾（GRSD），該方法從政策自身的驗證回合中推導出能力對齊和結果區分的指導。<lb/>對於每個提示，政策在一個政策內的群體中反思每個驗證的軌跡，並且停止梯度快照對比成功和失敗回合的結果反思，以構建群體級別的特權指導。<lb/>根據這一指導，自我教師通過調節基於結果的優勢來細化回合級別的信用分配，同時保持驗證者確定的學習方向。<lb/>在多個代理環境和模型規模下的實驗表明，GRSD始終優於競爭基準，並且對未見任務的泛化能力更強。
